scope: 84 retained binary/Koblitz systems m3..9, original/baseline/spike40, planted/natural; original top-form degree bounds only

files.protocol-chain.json: Frozen source/binary/case/base identities, limits and analysis plan
files.certificates/global.json: Rabin field proof; full83 and both selector27 Moore matrices/inverses; first/middle cubic coefficient certificates for both domains
files.certificates/controls.json: 30 explicit tiny Hilbert matrix calculations plus128 arithmetic checks
files.certificates/<key>.json: Complete input identity, all coordinate source-line hashes/top counts, selected disjoint blocks, final quadratic embedding relations, lower projection and full-system interval
files.certificates/partial-summary-NNN.json: Immutable cumulative snapshot after NNN cases; every snapshot retained
files.certificates/summary.json: All84 case results or explicit errors; unknown exact values are null
files.replay.json: Fresh-process recomputation summary hash and acceptance
files.development-validation/: Unit, build, Lean, controls and pre-freeze logs
files.manifest.sha256: Every raw file except manifest itself; verify before/after restored replay

encodings.field: Unsigned DECIMAL strings represent coefficients by bits in K=F2[z]/(z^83+z^45+z^2+z+1); parse exact integers
encodings.modulus_hex: HEX bit polynomial includes leading degree83 bit
encodings.matrix: Row k,col i equals weight_i^(2^k). Full83 matrix changes all intermediate coordinates; selector27 matrix uses first27 embeddings. Stored inverses verified both ways.
encodings.coordinate_equation_coefficients: 83 decimal K scalars combine source coordinate equations r=0..82 in a single chain group
encodings.coefficient_u128le_sha256: SHA256 of verified coefficients as16-byte little-endian integers in lexicographic Cartesian product order; for quadratic embedding proofs order is abstract product basis1,z,...,z^82
encodings.blocks: start_zero_based and width specify original variables; Singular v(i) is one-based
encodings.chain_equation: Zero-based S3 group; its coordinate r has one-based I[83*k+r+1]
encodings.top_counts: Number of canonical highest-degree monomials in each coordinate; every actual coefficient checked and expected support count matched
encodings.p0_scale: c_k=t^(2^k-1) for nonzero t; P_k+c_k*P_0 equals stored original-quadratic combination
encodings.lower_retained_variables: Projection retains first27 base selectors plus all83(m-2) intermediate variables
encodings.hashes: SHA256 over exact file/line bytes; source_line_sha256 excludes line-ending newline

claims_not_made: Exact full-chain regularity where bounds differ
replay: Extract complete raw archive to a fresh root; sha256sum -c manifest.sha256; instrument replay ROOT; recheck manifest. Never run producer into an existing root.
